# root help stays stable and readable in a real process
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --help
stdout 'Deploy and manage containerized applications on the Musher platform'

# the command groups
stdout 'Build:'
stdout 'Deploy:'
stdout 'Authentication:'
stdout 'Maintenance:'

# the verbs are listed under them
stdout 'init        Write a musher.yaml for a project'
stdout 'build       Build and push an image from musher.yaml'
stdout 'deploy      Deploy a container image'
stdout 'auth        Manage authentication'
stdout 'config      Manage Musher configuration'
stdout 'doctor      Diagnose common issues'

# the bundle-publishing surface is gone from help entirely
! stdout 'Authoring:'
! stdout 'bundle'
! stdout 'hub'
! stdout 'cache'
! stdout 'harness'

# and the commands themselves are unroutable
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input hub
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input cache
